record.category: paid-download file host (网赚网盘), VIP
record.tier: 高级会员 / 尊享会员

free_tier.stated: Free registration gives 100 GB per third-party documentation; the free download path is throttled to tens of KB/s with ads and a wait, which is what the VIP tiers remove.

per_object_cap.stated: 单文件最大 10GB, stated on the vendor's VIP page.

retention.stated: '文件永不删除' on the VIP page: files are not deleted for inactivity.

egress.terms: The paid tiers meter traffic, not time: 高级会员 is 存储空间 1T with 流量额度 1T at ¥39.7/month (list ¥40), 尊享会员 is 存储空间 1T with 流量额度 12T at ¥197 per 12 months (list ¥480), which the page renders as ¥16.41/month.
egress.free_allowance: 1 TB (高级) or 12 TB (尊享) of 流量额度

record.interface_detail: Browser plus any multi-threaded downloader; the vendor advertises '支持下载加速工具' and '多线程 / 断点续传'.
record.tooling: Browser, IDM, aria2. No WebDAV and no documented API.
record.chaining: The cheapest paid file host among debrid providers per unit of traffic: ¥197 buys 12 TB, ¥16.4/TB, provided the files are already published by someone else on this host.

limits.value: 1 TB 流量额度 (高级) or 12 TB (尊享); 存储空间 1 TB both
25 次高速传输请求/天 (高级) or 100 次/天 (尊享); a counter of fast pulls, not of bytes
1 TB trafii allowance (gaoji) or 12 TB (zunxiang); 1 TB storage on both
25 fast-transfer requests per day (gaoji) or 100 per day (zunxiang); a counter of fast pulls, not of bytes

identity_cost.detail: Purchase is by card through a reseller (PayPal) or in-page; the account itself was not read. The vendor page promises '购买后稍等几分钟即开通' and no refunds.

record.reliability_note: A 网赚 host: it pays uploaders per download, so the catalogue is monetised links and the domain has changed hands historically. Files are advertised as never deleted, which is unusual and unverified.
record.confidence_note: Both tiers, the traffic allowances, the per-file cap and the never-delete claim were read off the vendor's VIP page. The 100 GB free figure is third-party.

evidence.proved: '高级会员 / 存储空间 1T · 流量额度 1T 39.7 元/月 原价 40元'; '尊享会员 / 存储空间 1T · 流量额度 12T 16.41 元/月 原价 480元 现价 197元'; '单文件最大 10GB'; '文件永不删除'; '支持下载加速工具'; '多线程 / 断点续传'

an earlier landing variant of the same page: '高级會員 / 25次高速传输请求/天 1000G儲存 39.7 元/月', '尊享會員 / 100次高速传输请求/天 1000G儲存 12.37 元/月 原价 960元 现价 297元' - a 24-month promo, which is why the per-month figure differs
third party: free registration '100G 网盘', download rewards '高额的现金下载奖励'

gaoji: 1 TB storage with 1 TB of traffic at CNY 39.7/month (list CNY 40). zunxiang: 1 TB storage with 12 TB of traffic at CNY 197 per 12 months (list CNY 480), rendered as CNY 16.41/month. Both: 10 GB single file; 25 / 100 fast pulls per day.

record.price_per_tb_month: CNY 16.4 per TB of 流量额度 (尊享, ¥197 for 12 months and 12 TB)
record.notes: The 25/100 次高速传输请求/天 is a true pull-count in the vocabulary's sense and is rare enough to record: the vendor sells a number of fast pulls per day on top of a byte allowance. The two page variants disagree on the 尊享 price (¥197/12mo vs ¥297/24mo), both promotions, and the conservative per-month figure is recorded. The page does not say whether 流量额度 12T is per month or per term; the arithmetic says per term, because a monthly 12 TB at ¥16.41/month would undercut the 1 TB/month tier at ¥39.7 by a factor no seller would offer. The 高级 per-TB figure therefore stays unstated rather than assumed. The term reading is the record's inference, not a vendor statement, so the row is ranked with the flag rather than used to decide anything.
record.binding_note: The 流量额度 is what binds: 12 TB for ¥197 is ¥16.4/TB, the cheapest paid traffic measured among debrid providers, but it can only be spent on files this host already holds - it is not a route to an arbitrary link.

record.category: paid-download file host (网赚网盘), free path

free_tier.stated: 100 GB on registration, per third-party documentation of the vendor's own signup copy: '免费注册即可得到：100G 网盘'. Downloads on the free path are the throttled, ad-bearing path the VIP tiers exist to bypass.

per_object_cap.stated: Not published for the free path; the paid page's 单文件最大 10GB is the only cap the vendor states.

retention.stated: '文件永不删除' is claimed on the paid page for the service as a whole.

egress.terms: Free downloads are throttled to tens of KB/s with ads and a wait. Third-party write-ups describe '几十KB/s，甚至几KB/s', which is the same order as 百度网盘's free path.

record.interface_detail: Browser; the returned URL is fetchable by a multi-threaded client.
record.chaining: Not a retrieval route here at any volume; recorded because the free path is what most links on this host actually resolve to.

limits.value: free download '几十KB/s' per third-party reporting

identity_cost.detail: The registration form read shows email, password, password confirmation and captcha fields; a phone option is not shown on it. Whether a downloader needs an account is unverified.

record.reliability_note: Same operator, same monetisation: the free path is deliberately slow because uploaders are paid per download.
record.confidence_note: Neither the 100 GB nor the throttle figure is on a page on 2026-11-03 read from the vendor. Both are third-party. The vendor landing page publishes features only.

evidence.proved: landing page: '77File 云盘：稳定存储、极速下载、加密传输' - features only, no quota, no price
third party: '免费注册即可得到：100G 网盘', '通过下载量您将获得丰厚的回报'
third party: '下载速度只有几十KB/s，甚至几KB/s' on the free path
the registration form asks for an email address, not a phone number
evidence.quote: 请填写信息创建账号，邮箱务必正确，以便找回密码。

evidence.proved: the form fields are email, password, password confirmation and captcha
evidence.quote: 邮箱 密码 确认密码 验证码

evidence.proved: the 10 GB per-file maximum is on the VIP page, not the landing page
the never-deleted claim is on the VIP page, not the landing page
the landing page title advertises free large-capacity storage; no quota figure is on the page
evidence.quote: <title>77File 云盘 - 免费超大容量在线云存储</title>

evidence.proved: third party: free download speed of tens of KB/s, sometimes a few KB/s
evidence.quote: 下载速度只有几十KB/s，甚至几KB/s

evidence.proved: third party: the signup copy still lists a 100G disk on registration
evidence.quote: 100G 网盘: 与全球用户分享您的文件，无限存储空间，通过下载量您将获得丰厚的回报。

record.notes: Split from the VIP record because the two tiers differ in the thing that matters: one is the cheapest paid traffic in the sector, the other is unusable.
record.binding_note: A free pull at tens of KB/s cannot deliver a TiB in any month; the shaping is the wall and no byte counter exists to hit instead.
